other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a ward of a construction worker.
The construction worker must be registered with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must have secured 1st, 2nd or 3rd rank at the State or Regional level in the Higher Secondary course or its equivalent examination.
benefits_summary: One‑time cash prizes up to ₹1,00,000 for top ranks and annual educational assistance up to ₹4,000, disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
